name: EPIC 206515408
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 11.7 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,884 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.87 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,750 K at its surface.
